newsitem.title: USA: C-Phone in pact with Analog Devices.
newsitem.headline: C-Phone in pact with Analog Devices.

text.p: C-Phone Corp Friday said it will develop a family of video conferencing products through a joint development project with Analog Devices Inc.
C-Phone's stock gained 3-3/4 to 16 in morning trading.

"This relationship with Analog Devices has enabled us to build a high-performance, flexible and cost-effective videophone engine for certain of our C-Phone family of products," said C-Phone Chief Executive Daniel Flohr.
"We will now be able to distribute C-Phone products to the mass consumer market, as well as embed our technology in products which other manufacturers may determine to supply," he said.
The first jointly-developed product, C-Phone Home, is a home video system that allows users to see each other on standard television sets during a telephone conversation.
C-Phone is providing the integration software and hardware, along with the operating systems and user interface. Analog Devices and C-Phone engineers collaborated on the reference design.
C-Phone Home was demonstrated this week at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.
